chapter1.author: Myshko, A.
chapter1.title: МЕТАМОНИЗМ: Глава 1. Логические категории, оператор актуализации и возникновение первого инварианта
claims: D is the space of possible configurations of differences
I is the set of identity conditions/invariants
nontrivial actualization requires a pair in Dom(P)
R is the space of actualized results

chapter2.author: Myshko, A.
chapter2.title: МЕТАМОНИЗМ Глава 2. Продолжение актуализации: диссипация тождества, возникновение пространственности и временности и ортогональное разрешение
claims: Each actualized result may become the condition for the next act
F maps R_n to the next argument pair
F is not an additional fundamental principle
recursive continuation follows from the single prohibition

scope_rules: D is possibility space, not actualization trajectory
A_{n+1} is the next actualization argument state
I_* is foundational invariant and I_n is local argument condition
orthogonal resolution is downstream of continuation

frontier.question: What is the minimal formal structure of F that keeps repeated actualization inside Dom(P) without adding a new fundamental invariant or pre-imposing geometry?
